claims.claim: AGGREGATE IN SQL BEFORE RESOLVING IN PYTHON — algorithm D6, promoted to an ECOSYSTEM-LEVEL pattern (s097). The concept-drift algorithm took 430 seconds, and the SQL scan was never the bottleneck: 15,605,644 Python iterations were. Doing the GROUP BY in SQL first collapses those rows to 33,607 (month,object) pairs over 26,131 distinct objects — 548x less Python work — then the expensive resolution runs once per distinct entity instead of once per row. Plus a cache keyed on the latest audit date, so a re-run with no new data is free. MEASURED: 430s -> 187s cold -> 30s warm. WHY IT IS NOT MERELY AN OPTIMISATION: a slow algorithm gets skipped, and a skipped algorithm is documentation — the model stops learning without anyone deciding it should. CONSTRAINT that shaped it: the Golden DB is read-only by contract, so an index was not an option and the cache lives outside it. SHARED with all four ecosystem projects at ecosystem-coordinator/.knowledge/way-of-working/sql-aggregate-before-resolve.md — every project that enriches Golden DB rows in Python has this defect, and the candidates are named: CDHDR 7.8M, cdhdr_history 12M, REGUH 3.7M, FMIOI 2.2M.

evidence_for.cite: cold 3m07s (was 7m10s), warm 30s; 33,607 aggregated rows over 26,131 distinct objects

claims.resolution_notes: Rule of thumb recorded: if the row count entering Python exceeds the count of distinct things you actually resolve, you are doing avoidable work — and the ratio tells you how much. FAILURE MODE: the cache must be keyed on a watermark that MOVES; keyed on something static it serves stale results forever and looks fast while being wrong.

claims.claim: TRUNCATION FIXED, and my recorded CAUSE was wrong (s097). I had declared the failure mode as 'the destination parse truncates names'. THE FIX IS RECONCILIATION, NOT PARSING: a value that is a strict prefix of exactly ONE longer observed value is the same entity cut short. evidence_for.cite: 81 values repaired / 72 ambiguous; UNDECLARED 249 -> 176; fleets 17/21 -> 7/6

The structural fix priority is therefore: FIX-G1 (granular AVC per-FIPEX) + FIX-G2 (exclude REVENUE from TC pool) + FIX-G3 (enable AVC for non-Earmarked TYPEs that need it) + FIX-H (remove REVENUE preservation in YCL_YPS8_BCS_BL). incidents.root_cause_summary: 15-member ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE composite has gate-input asymmetry: Camp A (FR-anchored: CHECK_CONS, EF_FUND_RESERVATION, FUNDBLOCK) always fires for EUR FRs; Camp B (posting-anchored: PAYCOMMIT, NEW_ITEM, AVC, KBLEW, FI) silently skips when posting currency is not EUR. FR persisted at BR (1.09529); consumption persisted at identity. AVC pool drifts fund-by-fund until cover-group hits zero headroom. Vonthron's fund 3110111021/PAX/TC has $12,897.80 budget exactly matched by $12,897.80 of carryforward FR commitments -> Available=0 -> any new USD posting fires FMAVC005.

ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_AVC Enh1+3 (Camp B): iv_waers = <ls_fmioi>-twaer / <ls_fmifiit>-twaer per-row -> mixed, USD rows skip

incidents.root_cause_summary: CONFIRMED via TIER_1 RFC pull (P01, 2026-05-01). FM-AVC engine fires (NOT PS-AVC). The AVC derivation rule FMAFMAP013500109 collapses FIPEX 10'..50 into a single AVC control object TC for fund 196EAR4042. UNESCO loads donor revenue (WRTTP=66) entirely on FIPEX=REVENUE placeholder, which falls OUTSIDE the TC derivation range. Result: TC bucket sees /usr/bin/bash revenue while ,561,651.78 of KBFC consumption lands there → pool depth -,561,651.78 → FMAVC005 "Annual budget exceeded" raised for every new SES on FIPEX 11/20 (the three incident POs all hit the TC bucket). Fund-level pool is +1.83M and PS-AVC project pool is +6.43M — both healthy — but the FM-AVC enforces at the AVC-derived bucket level, not fund level. The class is REVENUE-PLACEHOLDER vs AVC-DERIVATION-BUCKET misalignment, structural to UNESCO config, present on 1,330+457 = 1,787 buckets across UNESCO (Tier 1+2 of the misalignment classifier).

incidents.title: F.05 FX revaluation: 'Account 1109574 blocked for posting' (Banco de Chile)
incidents.primary_subject: FX revaluation balance-sheet adjustment account blocked
incidents.scenario: F.05/SAPF100 (variant UNES_UNBA) revalues active CLP/USD Banco de Chile bank accounts. It posts the FX balance-sheet adjustment to the account configured in OB09/T030H (LKORR). That account is the CLOSED sub 1109574/1109571, blocked for posting.
error_messages: Account 1109574 UNES is blocked for posting
incidents.root_cause_summary: Unfinished bank sub-account migration. The Banco de Chile sub was retired (old 1109574 closed -> new 1110574 created) but OB09 was never repointed; the active main still points its LKORR adjustment to the closed sub. Two conditions needed for the runtime error: (1) OB09 points to a blocked sub AND (2) the main carries an FX balance to revalue.
incidents.code_validation_chain: F.05 -> SAPF100 -> T030H (KDF account determination) -> LKORR=1109574 -> SKB1.XSPEB='X' -> post aborts.
incidents.scope: 2 accounts in the failing variant range (1010574 CLP, 1010571 USD); 4 more share the defect but are out of variant scope.
incidents.fix_path: OB09/KDF: repoint 0001010574 -> 1110574 and 0001010571 -> 1110571 (active subs, like Ecobank 1094316->1194316). Do NOT unblock the closed subs. Confirm migration target with Treasury.

related_claims.claim: Two valid revaluation patterns: self-ref vs main+sub-account (Ecobank correct).
Root cause = unfinished OB09 sub-account migration (main -> closed sub).
Fix = repoint OB09 to the active sub for the 2 in-scope accounts.
F.05 runs interactively with 0 jobs; SM36 automation is the bigger opportunity.

capability_model._design: Layer 15 — Capability Model. The 4th axis of the domain taxonomy (after functional/module/process). Reflects the process+code+conformance work structurally: a domain is 'understood' only when 10 capability dimensions are covered for it (S precondition + A-H understanding + R composite readiness). ALIGN (re-express every domain on one skeleton) then EXPAND (every weak cell is the ranked roadmap). THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the matrix — do not hand-copy the matrix into prose docs (it drifts). Born Session #079.

_strata.note: A domain is a PAIR, not one model. The product lives in the delta. Capability G = compare AS_RUN against AS_DESIGNED. Conformance has TWO preconditions per domain: the standard baseline AND our process. Capturing AS_DESIGNED per domain is itself a precondition capability (S_STANDARD_REF below), mostly NONE today.
_strata.AS_DESIGNED: how SAP designed the domain — normative reference flow/objects/config as delivered (SAP Best Practices / PaPM reference content)
_strata.AS_RUN: how UNESCO actually does it — real process from data + Z-code/config/exits/.NET apps/workflows on top
_strata.DELTA: G_CONFORMANCE — where AS_RUN extends/deviates from AS_DESIGNED, down to the implementing object (the custom-over-standard x-ray)

U_USAGE.method: Fuse the execution-evidence channels into a per-domain object×actor×channel×time×volume census: RSAU/SM20 audit (Transaction Start->tcode, Report Start->program, RFC Function Call->function) + TBTCO/TBTCP (batch program+variant) + APQI/APQD (batch input / BDC). Scored: NONE=no census; PARTIAL=one channel or counts-only; HAVE=all 4 channels with actor+volume(+time).
U_USAGE.note: The AS-RUN usage layer. Distinct from B_CODE (STATIC: which code exists), A_PROCESS (the FLOW/variants) and E_AUTH (who CAN execute). U_USAGE = who ACTUALLY executes what, how, when, how much. Bridges static inventory -> live reality; the dead-vs-used signal also feeds R_S4_READINESS (used-to-migrate vs dead-to-delete). _concept._one_line: The PROFILE is what the TENANT IS. The capability model is what WE KNOW about it. Two different questions about the same system — and the delta between them is the work.

_why_a_new_concept.trigger: s097 — an external Business Process Review asked 'which modules are implemented and which are actively used'. The brain could not answer it. It held the HOW (operating model: 80.6% external orchestration; 37 integration flows) and it held OUR KNOWLEDGE (capability_model: domain x 11 capabilities), but nowhere did it hold the WHAT: the tenant's own footprint. The answer had to be re-derived live from cvers + audit logs and was wrong on 6 modules (RE-FX, SD, FI-AA, PM, TRM, PBC) plus an entire missing category (third-party add-ons).
_why_a_new_concept.diagnosis: Those 6 were not unknown — they were UNADDRESSED. PBC was in the brain as an 'engine' inside a prose doc; RE-FX had a domain folder; the add-ons had a companion. Knowledge existed but was not KEYED on the question being asked. A store you cannot query by the question you are asked is not knowledge, it is storage.
_why_a_new_concept.principle: CP-001 traceability + CP-003 evidence. A concept earns its place when a whole CLASS of question has no home. 'What is this tenant?' is that class.

_definition.profile: The measured reality of ONE tenant/system landscape: what is installed, what is configured, what is productive, how it is operated, who uses it, and through which channels data enters and leaves.
_definition.keyed_on: SAP APPLICATION COMPONENT (the technical module: FI-AA-AA, PA-PM-PB, RE-FX-CN...). This is deliberately a DIFFERENT axis from the capability model's canonical domain key.
not_the_profile: our coverage/knowledge of a domain -> that is capability_model (L15)
object-level graph -> that is L1 objects
an opinion, a roadmap or a recommendation -> the profile carries FACTS with evidence only

_evidence_tiers._rule: Every module MUST carry one of these. Never state a module without its tier — 'implemented' alone is the ambiguity that caused the s097 failure.
_evidence_tiers.INSTALLED: component present in CVERS. Near-meaningless on its own: 177 components are installed and most ship by default.
_evidence_tiers.CONFIGURED: organisational structure / customising exists (company code, sales org, plant, asset company code...).
_evidence_tiers.PRODUCTIVE: business documents exist AND/OR transactions are executed in the audit log.
_evidence_tiers.NOT_USED: the module exists but zero documents and zero executions — an ASSERTED negative, only valid when actually probed.
_evidence_tiers.NOT_EVIDENCED: we have no evidence either way. NOT the same as NOT_USED. Never collapse the two.
_evidence_tiers._adoption_is_a_separate_axis: Do NOT widen this vocabulary to express extent. The TIER answers 'how do we know?'; the optional `adoption` field (FULL/PARTIAL/MARGINAL) answers 'how far is it rolled out?'. Collapsing the two is what produced statuses like 'PARTIAL' that mean neither. Caught by the I1 gate on its first run — the gate paid for itself immediately.

_strata.note: The profile has three strata, in increasing order of what they cost to establish and of what they are worth.
_strata.1_footprint: installed / configured / productive per module + org structure. Cheap, factual, and the thing external parties always ask for first.
_strata.2_operation: HOW it is run: channel mix (dialog vs RFC vs IDoc vs batch vs file), who orchestrates, read vs write direction. This is where UNESCO's 80.6%-external headline lives.
_strata.3_periphery: what surrounds the core: third-party add-ons, the digital front-end (OData/Fiori), users and licences, and every channel through which data EXITS. Systematically forgotten, and the richest for a governance conversation.

_interrelations._design: The profile is not a leaf. It is the SPINE that the other stores hang off. Each link below is a LOOKUP (explicit key), never a fuzzy token match — the mistake ontology.json already had to correct once.
_interrelations.profile.module -> ontology.canonical_key: explicit `capability_domain` field per module. Resolves the technical module onto the canonical domain vocabulary.
_interrelations.profile.module -> capability_model.domai: via the above. Answers: for a module that is PRODUCTIVE, do we actually have capability coverage? A PRODUCTIVE module with no capability row is a SYSTEM-LEVEL BLIND SPOT — a different and more serious animal than the object-level blind_spots (L12), which are names we mentioned without a node.
_interrelations.profile.module -> claims: by domain + by related_objects. Every profile assertion must be traceable to a claim with evidence.
_interrelations.profile.module -> knowledge/domains/<x>/: the prose layer (artifact hierarchy: brain .md -> companion .html -> Word).
_interrelations.profile.operating_model -> knowledge/sys: the profile SUMMARISES; those docs stay the source of truth for per-flow detail. Never duplicate them here.
_interrelations.profile.third_party_addons -> F_INTERFAC: each add-on is an independent data-exit channel and therefore a governance object, not a licence line item.
_interrelations.profile -> capability_model: COMPLEMENTARY, NOT NESTED. Profile = the system. Capability model = our knowledge of it. Do not merge them; the delta between the two IS the backlog.

_module_to_domain._authority: EXPLICIT mapping, hand-maintained. `null` = no canonical domain exists yet -> that is a finding, not an error. s097: PBC/FI_AA/PM/SD/TRM/CO mapped to new same-named capability rows after the crossing exposed them as system-level blind spots.

_invariants.I1: Every module carries an evidence tier AND its evidence string. No tier without evidence.
_invariants.I2: NOT_USED requires an actual probe. Absence in the Gold DB or in executed_objects_domain_map is a FLOOR, never an inventory — it yields NOT_EVIDENCED, never NOT_USED.
_invariants.I3: Technical component names are resolved from the system (TADIR -> TDEVC -> DF14L), never from memory.
_invariants.I4: The profile is rendered into BRAIN_INDEX.md at bootstrap. If a session has to re-derive the footprint, the profile has failed — fix the profile, do not answer from scratch.
_invariants.I5: The profile is TENANT-SCOPED. Nothing here is portable to another client; the CONCEPT and the build scripts are.

_maintenance.who_updates: any session that measures something about the system's footprint, operation or periphery — before it answers, not after.
_maintenance.how: edit unesco_system_profile.json, then `python brain_v2/system_profile/build_profile_links.py` (also runs inside rebuild_all.py), which recomputes the interrelations and the gap report.
_maintenance.gate: build_profile_links.py FAILS LOUD on an invariant breach (module without tier, NOT_USED without evidence, unmapped module key).

_links._what_this_is: The PROFILE crossed against capability_model / ontology / claims / knowledge docs / companions. Read `system_level_blind_spots` first.

system_level_blind_spots._meaning: Modules the tenant runs IN PRODUCTION that have NO row in the capability model — i.e. our operating model has never looked at them. Distinct from L12 blind_spots (names without a graph node). These are the expensive ones.

capability_domains_without_a_profile_mod._meaning: The mirror gap: domains we model but never tied to a real module — either cross-cutting (Integration, Closing) or a modelling artefact to reconcile.

_model_graph._objective: Understand the MACRO profile THROUGH the details. Top-down alone is a fact-sheet; bottom-up is what makes it verifiable.

resolution._meaning: Which rung of the evidence ladder resolved each object. The DENOMINATOR matters: users, GL accounts, variants and synthesised concepts are not repository objects and can never carry an application component. Counting them as 'unresolved' measures the wrong thing — they are reported separately.
resolution._pct_meaning: of RESOLVABLE (repository) objects, not of all nodes

coherence._meaning: Does the macro assertion survive contact with the detail? A module asserted PRODUCTIVE with nothing modelled underneath is the model believing its own summary.

cross_cutting._meaning: Domains that span modules instead of owning one. They are not gaps in the module axis — they are a different KIND of domain, and each one enriches every module it touches.

_maturity_methods._concept: MODEL MATURITY METHODS — the repeatable activities that mature the model
_maturity_methods._one_line: Results are the output; METHODS are the product. A discovery that stays in a conversation dies with the session. A discovery turned into a runnable, scheduled check compounds.

_why.trigger: s097 discovered six productive modules the model had never seen, a whole category of third-party add-ons, and an entire missing brain concept (the PROFILE). Every one of those was found by an ACTIVITY, not by luck: a bounded probe, a crossing, a gate. If only the findings are recorded, the next blind spot waits for another accident.
_why.principle: The model is not the set of facts it holds. It is the set of activities it can repeat. Facts age; activities compound.
_why.test: For anything learned this session ask: what ACTIVITY found it, is that activity runnable, and does it run on its own? If the answer to any of those is no, the learning is not yet part of the product.

_lifecycle.1_discovered: an activity performed by hand in a conversation, once
_lifecycle.2_scripted: written as a runnable tool with its inputs and outputs declared
_lifecycle.3_wired: runs inside rebuild_all.py — it can no longer be forgotten
_lifecycle.4_gated: FAILS the rebuild when its invariant is breached — it can no longer be ignored
_lifecycle.5_measured: its output feeds a maturity metric, so we can see the model getting better
_lifecycle._rule: An activity below stage 3 is not part of the product yet. Promote it or drop it — do not leave it at stage 1 as a note.

M1_footprint_probe.activity: Bounded read-only probe of the tenant's module footprint (org structure + document volumes per module).
M1_footprint_probe.answers: Which modules are CONFIGURED and which are PRODUCTIVE — as opposed to merely installed.
M1_footprint_probe.fires: on demand + whenever a scope question arrives that the profile cannot answer
M1_footprint_probe.found_in_s097: FI-AA, SD, PM, TRM and RE-FX are all PRODUCTIVE — all five had been reported as 'not implemented / not evidenced'.
M1_footprint_probe.invariant: bounded: WHERE year >= 2024 and a ROWCOUNT cap. A hit cap is reported as '>=cap', NEVER as an exact count.
M1_footprint_probe.cost: ~2 minutes, read-only, no writes to SAP

M2_component_resolution.activity: Resolve any SAP object to its APPLICATION COMPONENT via the system's own taxonomy: TADIR -> TDEVC -> DF14L.
M2_component_resolution.answers: What does this object belong to? — the deterministic bottom-up rung.
M2_component_resolution.fires: when the component hierarchy is stale or a new object type is needed
M2_component_resolution.writes_to: Gold DB tables df14l (2,687 components) + tadir_obj (311K objects across 10 types)
M2_component_resolution.found_in_s097: PBC = PA-PM-PB, which sits under Personnel Management and not under PSM. That single fact explains why an FM-shaped search never found the largest staff-budget capability in the tenant.
M2_component_resolution.why_it_beats_the_alternative: Package-name regex is guessing. DF14L is SAP stating the answer. Coverage of graph objects rose from 4% to 100% of resolvable objects once the chain spanned object TYPES, not just programs.
M2_component_resolution.invariant: never infer a component from a name when the chain can resolve it

M3_profile_crossing.activity: Cross the PROFILE against capability model / ontology / claims / docs / companions.
M3_profile_crossing.answers: For every module the tenant RUNS, do we actually model it?
M3_profile_crossing.produces: SYSTEM-LEVEL BLIND SPOTS = productive module with no capability row
M3_profile_crossing.found_in_s097: 6 blind spots on first run — CO, FI_AA, PM, SD, TRM, PBC — reproducing, from structure alone, exactly the six modules the conversation had got wrong.
M3_profile_crossing.gates: I1 tier+evidence per module · I2 NOT_USED requires a probe · mapping completeness
M3_profile_crossing.caught_immediately: two ill-formed statuses (PARTIAL/MARGINAL) that were conflating evidence with adoption

M4_bidirectional_ascent.activity: Climb from every object up to the installation, recording WHICH rung of the evidence ladder resolved it.
M4_bidirectional_ascent.answers: Can we understand the macro profile THROUGH the details? — the stated objective.
M4_bidirectional_ascent.invariant: the rung is ALWAYS recorded — a curated assignment must never be presented as an inference (CP-003)
M4_bidirectional_ascent.metric: pct of graph objects that resolve upward. s097 baseline: 64.5%.
M4_bidirectional_ascent.improves_by: extending TADIR coverage to more object types and closing the unresolved tail

M5_coherence_check.activity: Compare the macro tier asserted top-down against the evidence found bottom-up, per module.
M5_coherence_check.answers: Is the model believing its own summary?

verdicts.UNSUPPORTED: asserted PRODUCTIVE with zero objects underneath — an assertion with no detail behind it
verdicts.THIN: productive but almost nothing modelled underneath
verdicts.OK: the macro survives contact with the detail

M5_coherence_check.found_in_s097: flagged MM and Payment_BCM as unsupported — which turned out to be an ALIAS DEFECT in the checker itself, not a modelling gap. A self-check that fails loudly is how you find defects in the checker.
M5_coherence_check.why_it_matters: This is the only mechanism that can detect the model drifting away from the system it describes.

M6_cross_cutting_overlay.activity: Classify domains that SPAN modules rather than owning one, and make the enrichment edge explicit.
M6_cross_cutting_overlay.answers: What enriches every module instead of belonging to one?
M6_cross_cutting_overlay.found_in_s097: The 'mirror gap' (domains modelled with no module behind them) was not a defect. Those domains are a different KIND. Declaring the kind turned an anomaly into structure.
M6_cross_cutting_overlay.principle: Before treating an anomaly as an error, ask whether it is a category the model lacks.
M6_cross_cutting_overlay.fires: rebuild_all.py step 2d; revisit when a new domain has no module

M7_vocabulary_gate.activity: Refuse any domain key that does not resolve against the canonical ontology.
M7_vocabulary_gate.found_in_s097: rejected the 6 new domains until they were declared. Vocabulary stays canonical BY CONSTRUCTION, not by anyone remembering.
M7_vocabulary_gate.principle: A rule enforced by a human is a wish. A rule enforced by a gate is a property.

M8_alias_resolution.activity: Resolve any domain/doc/module spelling through the ontology's declared aliases before concluding something is missing.
M8_alias_resolution.found_in_s097: 4 domain docs reported as MISSING already existed under alias folder names (PSM_FM->PSM, Payment_BCM->Payment, Treasury_EBS->Treasury, MM->Procurement). Writing them would have duplicated existing knowledge (CP-002 breach).
M8_alias_resolution.recurrence: This same defect appeared THREE times in one session — doc resolution, claim matching, coherence checking. It is the single most repeated failure mode in this codebase.
M8_alias_resolution.invariant: never compare domain names raw; always normalise through the ontology first
M8_alias_resolution.fires: continuously — imported by every consumer via brain_v2/canonical.py

M9_skill_coverage_audit.activity: Audit the portable skill against the repository's real tool surface.
M9_skill_coverage_audit.answers: Is the machine we claim to have the machine we actually have?
M9_skill_coverage_audit.fires: per close + after any new tool is added
M9_skill_coverage_audit.found_in_s097: the first skill draft named 9 of 80 capabilities (11%). Writing a skill from memory is not an audit.
M9_skill_coverage_audit.invariant: three populations kept apart — capability / instance / legacy. Conflating them inflates or deflates the number.

M10_capability_reevaluation.activity: Walk the capability catalogue and move at least one STATE upward.
M10_capability_reevaluation.answers: Which capability is weakest, and what is the specific lever?
M10_capability_reevaluation.why: Capabilities that are never re-evaluated never improve. A catalogue entry whose Improve line has not changed in five sessions is either finished or abandoned — decide which.
M10_capability_reevaluation.current_portfolio: STRONG 11 · WORKS 12 · WEAK 4 · FRAGILE 1 (accumulate_logs: most valuable, least protected)

M11_trigger_evaluation.activity: Evaluate accumulation / maturity / interpretation triggers against the model's current state.
M11_trigger_evaluation.answers: What needs re-running RIGHT NOW, and why?

families.ACCUMULATION: enough new evidence arrived that an answer may have changed
families.MATURITY: a score moved the wrong way — the model detecting its own regression
families.INTERPRETATION: new logs or interfaces can CHANGE THE MEANING of a domain, not just add to it

M11_trigger_evaluation.principle: A domain assignment is a HYPOTHESIS carried with its evidence window. Extend the window materially and it is due for re-derivation.

M12_investment_alignment.activity: Measure whether capability sits where the work is, and whether the DIFFERENTIATOR tier is our strongest.
M12_investment_alignment.answers: Is the portfolio aligned with the product thesis?
M12_investment_alignment.found_in_s097: MISALLOCATED — PS, PBC and Cost_Recovery_CRP are differentiator-tier and under-modelled, while PS carries 402,845 executions per asset.

M13_path_integrity.question: does every field that claims to hold a path actually hold one?
M13_path_integrity.why: a path field holding prose makes every check over it silently wrong — not loudly broken, WRONG. C3 was reported as an unimplemented idea while its tool was on disk and running. The catalogue lying about itself is worse than a gap, because a gap is visible.
M13_path_integrity.fires: rebuild_all step 0a3 + the analysis cycle + per close
M13_path_integrity.promotion: born s097 from a defect found twice in one hour, in two different stores. Promoted from correction to gate on the second sighting — the rule this project keeps re-learning is that a defect appearing twice is structural.

_anti_methods._note: Activities that LOOK like evidence and are not. Each cost real errors in s097.
_anti_methods.A1_absence_in_a_derived_index: Absence in executed_objects_domain_map or in the Gold DB is a FLOOR, never an inventory. It yields NOT_EVIDENCED, never NOT_USED. Cost: 5 modules wrongly reported as not implemented.
_anti_methods.A2_substring_name_matching: Matching a module name as a substring of free text. 'CO' matched 337 claims, 'PM' 47, 'SD' 30 — noise presented as coverage, which is worse than an empty list because it reads as linkage.
_anti_methods.A3_suppressing_a_generic_error: TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA was being swallowed as 'empty is normal'. It was masking an INVALID FIELD (PARENT_ID on DF14L), and three extraction runs returned 0 rows with no error. Never suppress a generic error class without first confirming what it is hiding.
_anti_methods.A4_answering_from_memory: SAP component codes, table names and field names must be resolved from the system. Every code in the profile came from DF14L, not recall.

_next_promotions._note: Activities still at stage 1-2. Each is a known lever, not a vague idea.
_next_promotions.P1: Schedule M1 (footprint probe) to re-run periodically — the footprint DRIFTS as the tenant changes, and nothing currently detects that.
_next_promotions.P2: Raise M4 ascent above 64.5% by extending TADIR coverage past the 40,000-row cap per object type (P01 rejects ROWSKIPS, so chunk by name range instead).
_next_promotions.P3: Feed M5 coherence into meta_capability.py so model drift becomes a MEASURED maturity lever rather than a report nobody reads.
